Ranks Montgomery census tracts by CDC adult asthma prevalence (per adult population, with totalpop18plus retained as the denominator) and left-joins each tract's pre-aggregated 2025 code-violation count, keeping tracts without violations as zero and geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH asthma AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_rate,
    CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus
  FROM session.fw_d6337e_m1_cdc
  WHERE casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
),
violations AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    SUM(n) AS code_violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_d6337e' AND source = 'm2_city' AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT
  t.name AS tract_name,
  a.adult_asthma_rate,
  a.totalpop18plus,
  COALESCE(v.code_violations_2025, 0) AS code_violations_2025,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t
LEFT JOIN asthma AS a ON a.geoid = t.geoid
LEFT JOIN violations AS v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
WHERE a.adult_asthma_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.adult_asthma_rate DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
